entities.title: Ship rig
entities.summary: The ship script that poses a rigged ship's parts, and the GLB post-import script.
entities.purpose: ship.gd eases each ship's channels (turrets, brakes) toward their targets and poses its parts; ship_import.gd turns a ship GLB into a rigged ship: glTF extras to node metadata, the second UV set to the first, +X forward to Godot's −Z.
boundaries: The rig contract every ship GLB follows is DESIGN § Rig contract.
The models themselves are in assets/ships/.
